summary: Peabody Energy Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 3 to its existing Credit Agreement, increasing revolving commitments from $320M to $400M, extending the maturity from January 2028 to June 2030, and reducing interest rate margins by 25 bps. This is a routine debt facility amendment—a material definitive agreement but not a transformative special situation. No change of control, premium, shareholder vote, or strategic event is involved. Watch for no further implications; this is purely a liability management move with no risk-arb angle.
